summary: Spire Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its board approved an updated form of indemnification agreement with its directors and officers. The agreement indemnifies Indemnitees to the fullest extent permitted by Missouri law, provides for advancement of legal fees, and maintains D&O insurance coverage. No financial terms, premiums, or transaction consideration are involved. This is a routine corporate governance matter regarding director/officer protection, not a special situation event. It does not relate to acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or any other transformative corporate event.
